title: Bitcoin Price Fades Near $61,000 as Stocks Soar on Huang’s Return
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Price Fades Near $61,000 as Stocks Soar on Huang’s Return The bitcoin price gave back its Nvidia-fueled spike above $64,000 on Monday afternoon, slipping near $61,000 while stocks and crypto shares held big gains. This post Bitcoin Price Fades Near $61,000 as Stocks Soar on Huang’s Return first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
